_comment: Development fixture in the exact shape scripts/generate-tools.mjs produces. Copy it over public/tools.json to work on the release, changelog and download UI without GitHub access — and do not commit that copy. The unit tests import this file directly, so it is also what pins the contract between the generator and the app: if the generator's output shape changes, change this file and the specs fail until the app agrees. Covers the two cases that matter: a repo with a tool.json, a release and assets, and a bare repo with neither.

summary.de: Spiegelt jede Spout2- oder NDI-Quelle als schwebendes Fenster auf deinen zweiten Monitor.
summary.en: Mirrors any Spout2 or NDI source into a floating window on your second monitor.

de: Phantom Mirror nimmt eine Spout2- oder NDI-Quelle und zeigt sie als randloses Fenster an, das du frei positionieren kannst.
Gedacht für alles, was du im Auge behalten musst, während du spielst.
en: Phantom Mirror takes a Spout2 or NDI source and shows it as a borderless window you can place anywhere.
Meant for whatever you need to keep an eye on while you play.

de: In OBS das Spout2-Plugin oder den NDI-Output aktivieren.
PhantomMirror.exe starten und die Quelle auswählen.
en: Download the release and unpack it.
Enable the Spout2 plugin or the NDI output in OBS.
Run PhantomMirror.exe and pick your source.
